name: Corporate ownership
description: Companies, beneficial ownership, governance, products, contracts and commercial activity.

entity_types.label: Company
entity_types.description: A named incorporated or commercially operating company.

entity_types.label: Subsidiary
entity_types.description: A company explicitly described as controlled by a parent organization.

entity_types.label: Holding company
entity_types.description: A named company primarily described as holding or controlling other entities.

entity_types.label: Investment fund
entity_types.description: A named investment fund or collective investment vehicle.

entity_types.label: Joint venture
entity_types.description: A named jointly controlled commercial venture.

entity_types.label: Commercial facility
entity_types.description: A named factory, warehouse, office, mine, plant or other operating site.

entity_types.label: Business program
entity_types.description: A named corporate, investment or industrial programme.

entity_types.label: Commercial service
entity_types.description: A named service offered by an organization to customers or partners.

entity_types.label: Contract
entity_types.description: A specifically named or identified commercial contract or procurement agreement.
